method: Built-in image_gen; original character art and supplementary action sheets. Offline sprite registration and WebP packaging use sharp.

base.sh: Original friendly chibi male student, rounded cropped black hair, warm peach skin, mustard yellow zip hoodie with ivory drawstrings and kangaroo pocket, charcoal trousers and ivory sneakers. Detailed warm pixel art, consistent 2.6-head-tall proportions. A transparent 6-column / 8-row sheet; six consecutive frames per action, fixed foot baseline, same scale. Rows: idle with breathing/glance/blink; walk right with opposing arms and alternating contact/passing gait; walk toward camera; walk away from camera; read and turn a sage book page; raise ivory mug, sip and lower; right-facing hand gestures and nods; right-facing watering can tipping and pouring. All 48 full bodies isolated, no grid, text, scenery, shadows or cropped limbs.
base.wg:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: transparent game character animation sprite atlas.
Input image 1 is a STYLE, SCALE and ANIMATION GRID reference. Make a new crew member, replacing only the student identity/outfit in EVERY cell with this description: Woong, a friendly young adult male student with short tousled jet-black hair, a visible little tuft, warm peach skin, bright gentle eyes. Emerald/sage GREEN cardigan with ivory shirt and collar visible underneath, small ivory buttons, dark charcoal trousers, ivory sneakers. No glasses, no hood, no bag.
Keep the reference's polished detailed pixel-chibi style, warm controlled pixel clusters, fine hair highlights, soft fabric shading, expressive facial features and 2.6-head-tall full-body proportions. Keep its same 6-column, 8-row grid with EXACTLY 48 separately framed complete characters, no missing sprites. Actual transparent background, no checkerboard, no labels, no grid lines, no floor shadows, no scenery. Output aspect ratio exactly 3:4, preferably 1536x2048 pixels.
All cells equally sized, same character scale and proportional height across all 48 frames. Each sprite centered in its own cell, soles on the same baseline near the bottom of that cell with at least 10px bottom padding and 15px padding around all sides. Keep hands, feet, hair and props entirely inside each cell. No sprite overlaps. Keep head size, facial features, clothing details, and shoe shape consistent.
Rows top to bottom MUST MATCH this order:
1: six forward idle frames, relaxed, inhale, glance, blink, exhale, relaxed; subtle expressions and breathing, fixed feet.
2: six consecutive RIGHT profile walking frames forming a loop. CRITICAL: true gait, frame1 right foot forward/left back, frame2 legs narrowing, frame3 feet passing under hips with bent knee, frame4 left foot forward/right back, frame5 legs narrowing, frame6 opposite knee passing. Opposite arm swing. NOT six identical wide strides.
3: six FRONT view walking frames, same genuine alternating contact/passing foot cycle.
4: six BACK view walking away frames, no face visible, same alternating contact/passing foot cycle.
5: six reading frames, small open sage-green book held at chest, eyes track the page, turn a page and return.
6: six three-quarter-right tea-drinking frames, raise ivory mug, sip at lips, smile, lower and settle.
7: six three-quarter RIGHT-facing conversation frames, small hand gestures, smiling and nodding, open palm then settle.
8: six RIGHT-facing watering frames, sage-green watering can held in both hands, tip to pour droplets right, return upright. No plants or scenery.
Do not simply recolor the reference: use the described distinct hairstyle, face, outfit and accessories consistently. Preserve the reference's clear sprite separation and readable motions.

actions.sh:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production game animation atlas. Use reference image 1 ONLY for the exact identity and pixel-chibi style of the yellow-hoodie boy. Do NOT copy its checkerboard background.
Create 24 full-body sprites in a strict grid of 6 COLUMNS and 4 ROWS, aspect ratio 3:2, preferably 1536x1024 pixels. Every cell equally sized. Same exact character, hairstyle, face, outfit, colors and softly shaded crisp fine pixel-art rendering throughout. All complete bodies and props fit within their cells with at least 15px padding. Consistent torso/head size. Fixed soles baseline near bottom, plenty of headroom for raised hands. No per-frame changes of scale.
Row 1: six FRONT VIEW consecutive STUDY animation frames, writing with a dark pencil in a small cream notebook held at waist level, attentive downward gaze. Standing full body, feet planted.
Row 2: six BACK VIEW BOOKSHELF browsing frames: back of head and outfit toward camera, no face visible, left hand holds closed sage book, right arm reaches upward/forward, open fingers, take an imaginary book, lower it, settle. No bookshelf drawn.
Row 3: six BACK VIEW COFFEE MAKING frames: back of head and outfit toward camera, no face visible, hold small ivory mug in left hand near waist, right hand reaches forward, presses an imaginary button, return hand, lift mug slightly, settle. No machine drawn.
Row 4: six FRONT VIEW STRETCHING: hands at sides, arms lift, stretch hands overhead, tip head with smiling closed eyes, lower arms, settle. Feet planted. Keep arms/hair/shoes fully visible with identical character scale across the sequence.
Each row exactly six clearly separated loopable motion frames. No duplicated rows, no tables, chairs, bookshelves or coffee machines. No text, labels, frame borders, shadows, floor or scenery.
CRITICAL OUTPUT: a genuinely TRANSPARENT PNG with RGBA alpha channel. All pixels outside character silhouettes must be alpha=0. NOT a checkerboard picture, NOT gray squares, NOT an opaque background. Checkerboard backgrounds would make this unusable. Only the sprites exist on transparent empty pixels.
